articles.summary: GLENVILLE, N.Y., April 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - TrustCo Bank Corp NY (TrustCo, Nasdaq: TRST) today announced that it will release first quarter 2026 results after the market close on April 21, 2026. Results are released on the 21 st of the reporting months (January, April, July and October), or on the next day that equity markets are open if the 21 st falls on a Friday, weekend or holiday. A conference call to discuss the results will be held at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on April 22, 2026. Those wishing to participate in the call may dial toll-free for the United States and Canada at 1-888-672-2415, Conference ID 4207347. A replay of the call will be available for thirty days by dialing toll-free for the United States and Canada at 1-800-770-2030, Playback ID 4207347. The call will also be audio webcast at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/269280990 , and will be available for one year.
